bundle.shortDescription: NuXL: protein-nucleic acid cross-links identified with OpenNuXL of OpenMS
bundle.longDescription: NuXL identifies protein-RNA and protein-DNA cross-links in MS/MS spectra (mzML, Thermo .raw or Bruker timsTOF .d) against a protein database (FASTA) with OpenNuXL of OpenMS, rescores with Percolator, and shows the cross-links, peptides and proteins with their adducts, cross-linked residues and annotated spectra. Everything runs on this computer.
